scheme_name: Civil Service Incentive (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic communities )
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to De‑notified, Nomadic, or Semi‑Nomadic communities.
Applicant must have cleared either the Preliminary, Main or Interview stage of the MPPSC or UPSC examination.
benefits_summary: Provides a cash incentive ranging from ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 depending on the examination level and whether it is conducted by MPPSC or UPSC.
